verses.arabic: قُلْ أُوحِىَ إِلَىَّ أَنَّهُ ٱسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْءَانًا عَجَبًۭا
verses.english: Say, ‘It has been revealed to me that a team of the jinn listened [to the Quran] and they said, “Indeed we heard a wonderful Quran,
verses.transliteration_html: Qul oohiya ilayya annahu istamaAAa nafarun mina aljinni faqaloo inna samiAAna quranan AAajaban
verses.transliteration_text: Qul oohiya ilayya annahu istamaAAa nafarun mina aljinni faqaloo inna samiAAna quranan AAajaban

verses.arabic: يَهْدِىٓ إِلَى ٱلرُّشْدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِۦ ۖ وَلَن نُّشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَدًۭا
verses.english: which guides to rectitude. Hence, we have believed in it and we will never ascribe any partner to our Lord.
verses.transliteration_html: Yahdee ila alrrushdi faamanna bihi walan nushrika birabbina ahadan
verses.transliteration_text: Yahdee ila alrrushdi faamanna bihi walan nushrika birabbina ahadan

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ تَعَـٰلَىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا ٱتَّخَذَ صَـٰحِبَةًۭ وَلَا وَلَدًۭا
verses.english: Exalted be the majesty of our Lord; He has taken neither any spouse nor son.
verses.transliteration_html: Waannahu taAAala jaddu rabbina ma ittakhatha sahibatan wala waladan
verses.transliteration_text: Waannahu taAAala jaddu rabbina ma ittakhatha sahibatan wala waladan

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ شَطَطًۭا
verses.english: The foolish ones among us used to speak atrocious lies concerning Allah.
verses.transliteration_html: Waannahu kana yaqoolu safeehuna AAala Allahi shatatan
verses.transliteration_text: Waannahu kana yaqoolu safeehuna AAala Allahi shatatan

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن تَقُولَ ٱلْإِنسُ وَٱلْجِنُّ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًۭا
verses.english: We thought that humans and jinn would never utter any falsehood concerning Allah.
verses.transliteration_html: Waanna thananna an lan taqoola alinsu waaljinnu AAala Allahi kathiban
verses.transliteration_text: Waanna thananna an lan taqoola alinsu waaljinnu AAala Allahi kathiban

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ رِجَالٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْإِنسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمْ رَهَقًۭا
verses.english: Indeed some persons from the humans would seek the protection of some persons from the jinn, thus only adding to their rebellion.
verses.transliteration_html: Waannahu kana rijalun mina alinsi yaAAoothoona birijalin mina aljinni fazadoohum rahaqan
verses.transliteration_text: Waannahu kana rijalun mina alinsi yaAAoothoona birijalin mina aljinni fazadoohum rahaqan

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّهُمْ ظَنُّوا۟ كَمَا ظَنَنتُمْ أَن لَّن يَبْعَثَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدًۭا
verses.english: They thought, just as you think, that Allah will not raise anyone from the dead.
verses.transliteration_html: Waannahum thannoo kama thanantum an lan yabAAatha Allahu ahadan
verses.transliteration_text: Waannahum thannoo kama thanantum an lan yabAAatha Allahu ahadan

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّا لَمَسْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ فَوَجَدْنَـٰهَا مُلِئَتْ حَرَسًۭا شَدِيدًۭا وَشُهُبًۭا
verses.english: Indeed we made for the heaven and found it full of mighty sentries and flames.
verses.transliteration_html: Waanna lamasna alssamaa fawajadnaha muliat harasan shadeedan washuhuban
verses.transliteration_text: Waanna lamasna alssamaa fawajadnaha muliat harasan shadeedan washuhuban

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقْعُدُ مِنْهَا مَقَـٰعِدَ لِلسَّمْعِ ۖ فَمَن يَسْتَمِعِ ٱلْـَٔانَ يَجِدْ لَهُۥ شِهَابًۭا رَّصَدًۭا
verses.english: We used to sit in its positions to eavesdrop, but anyone listening now finds a flame waiting for him.
verses.transliteration_html: Waanna kunna naqAAudu minha maqaAAida lilssamAAi faman yastamiAAi alana yajid lahu shihaban rasadan
verses.transliteration_text: Waanna kunna naqAAudu minha maqaAAida lilssamAAi faman yastamiAAi alana yajid lahu shihaban rasadan

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّا لَا نَدْرِىٓ أَشَرٌّ أُرِيدَ بِمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ أَرَادَ بِهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ رَشَدًۭا
verses.english: We do not know whether ill is intended for those who are on the earth, or whether their Lord intends good for them.
verses.transliteration_html: Waanna la nadree asharrun oreeda biman fee alardi am arada bihim rabbuhum rashadan
verses.transliteration_text: Waanna la nadree asharrun oreeda biman fee alardi am arada bihim rabbuhum rashadan

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلصَّـٰلِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ كُنَّا طَرَآئِقَ قِدَدًۭا
verses.english: Among us some are righteous and some are otherwise: we are various sects.
verses.transliteration_html: Waanna minna alssalihoona waminna doona thalika kunna taraiqa qidadan
verses.transliteration_text: Waanna minna alssalihoona waminna doona thalika kunna taraiqa qidadan

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن نُّعْجِزَ ٱللَّهَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَن نُّعْجِزَهُۥ هَرَبًۭا
verses.english: We know that we cannot frustrate Allah on the earth, nor can we frustrate Him by fleeing.
verses.transliteration_html: Wanna thananna an lan nuAAjiza Allaha fee alardi walan nuAAjizahu haraban
verses.transliteration_text: Wanna thananna an lan nuAAjiza Allaha fee alardi walan nuAAjizahu haraban

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعْنَا ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ ۖ فَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِرَبِّهِۦ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخْسًۭا وَلَا رَهَقًۭا
verses.english: When we heard the [message of] guidance, we believed in it. Whoever that has faith in his Lord will fear neither privation nor oppression.
verses.transliteration_html: Waanna lamma samiAAna alhuda amanna bihi faman yumin birabbihi fala yakhafu bakhsan wala rahaqan
verses.transliteration_text: Waanna lamma samiAAna alhuda amanna bihi faman yumin birabbihi fala yakhafu bakhsan wala rahaqan

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلْمُسْلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا ٱلْقَـٰسِطُونَ ۖ فَمَنْ أَسْلَمَ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ تَحَرَّوْا۟ رَشَدًۭا
verses.english: Among us some are Muslims and some of us are perverse.” ’ Those who submit [to Allah]—it is they who pursue rectitude.
verses.transliteration_html: Waanna minna almuslimoona waminna alqasitoona faman aslama faolaika taharraw rashadan
verses.transliteration_text: Waanna minna almuslimoona waminna alqasitoona faman aslama faolaika taharraw rashadan

verses.arabic: وَأَمَّا ٱلْقَـٰسِطُونَ فَكَانُوا۟ لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبًۭا
verses.english: As for the perverse, they will be firewood for hell.
verses.transliteration_html: Waama alqasitoona fakanoo lijahannama hataban
verses.transliteration_text: Waama alqasitoona fakanoo lijahannama hataban

verses.arabic: وَأَلَّوِ ٱسْتَقَـٰمُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلطَّرِيقَةِ لَأَسْقَيْنَـٰهُم مَّآءً غَدَقًۭا
verses.english: If they are steadfast on the path [of Allah], We shall provide them with abundant water,
verses.transliteration_html: Waallawi istaqamoo AAala alttareeqati laasqaynahum maan ghadaqan
verses.transliteration_text: Waallawi istaqamoo AAala alttareeqati laasqaynahum maan ghadaqan

verses.arabic: لِّنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيهِ ۚ وَمَن يُعْرِضْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِۦ يَسْلُكْهُ عَذَابًۭا صَعَدًۭا
verses.english: so that We may test them therein, and whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord, He will let him into an escalating punishment.
verses.transliteration_html: Linaftinahum feehi waman yuAArid AAan thikri rabbihi yaslukhu AAathaban saAAadan
verses.transliteration_text: Linaftinahum feehi waman yuAArid AAan thikri rabbihi yaslukhu AAathaban saAAadan

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّ ٱلْمَسَـٰجِدَ لِلَّهِ فَلَا تَدْعُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدًۭا
verses.english: The places of worship belong to Allah, so do not invoke anyone along with Allah.
verses.transliteration_html: Waanna almasajida lillahi fala tadAAoo maAAa Allahi ahadan
verses.transliteration_text: Waanna almasajida lillahi fala tadAAoo maAAa Allahi ahadan

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبْدُ ٱللَّهِ يَدْعُوهُ كَادُوا۟ يَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِ لِبَدًۭا
verses.english: When the servant of Allah rose to pray to Him, they almost crowded around him.
verses.transliteration_html: Waannahu lamma qama AAabdu Allahi yadAAoohu kadoo yakoonoona AAalayhi libadan
verses.transliteration_text: Waannahu lamma qama AAabdu Allahi yadAAoohu kadoo yakoonoona AAalayhi libadan

verses.arabic: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَدْعُوا۟ رَبِّى وَلَآ أُشْرِكُ بِهِۦٓ أَحَدًۭا
verses.english: Say, ‘I pray only to my Lord, and I do not ascribe any partner to Him.’
verses.transliteration_html: Qul innama adAAoo rabbee wala oshriku bihi ahadan
verses.transliteration_text: Qul innama adAAoo rabbee wala oshriku bihi ahadan

verses.arabic: قُلْ إِنِّى لَآ أَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ ضَرًّۭا وَلَا رَشَدًۭا
verses.english: Say, ‘I have no power to bring you any harm or good [of my own accord].’
verses.transliteration_html: Qul innee la amliku lakum darran wala rashadan
verses.transliteration_text: Qul innee la amliku lakum darran wala rashadan

verses.arabic: قُلْ إِنِّى لَن يُجِيرَنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدٌۭ وَلَنْ أَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مُلْتَحَدًا
verses.english: Say, ‘Neither can anyone shelter me from Allah, nor can I find any refuge besides Him.
verses.transliteration_html: Qul innee lan yujeeranee mina Allahi ahadun walan ajida min doonihi multahadan
verses.transliteration_text: Qul innee lan yujeeranee mina Allahi ahadun walan ajida min doonihi multahadan

verses.arabic: إِلَّا بَلَـٰغًۭا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِسَـٰلَـٰتِهِۦ ۚ وَمَن يَعْصِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا
verses.english: [I have no duty] except to transmit from Allah, and [to communicate] His messages; and whoever disobeys Allah and His apostle, there will indeed be for him the fire of hell, to remain in it forever.’
verses.transliteration_html: Illa balaghan mina Allahi warisalatihi waman yaAAsi Allaha warasoolahu fainna lahu nara jahannama khalideena feeha abadan
verses.transliteration_text: Illa balaghan mina Allahi warisalatihi waman yaAAsi Allaha warasoolahu fainna lahu nara jahannama khalideena feeha abadan

verses.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوْا۟ مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَضْعَفُ نَاصِرًۭا وَأَقَلُّ عَدَدًۭا
verses.english: When they see what they are promised, they will know who is weaker in supporters and fewer in numbers.
verses.transliteration_html: Hatta itha raaw ma yooAAadoona fasayaAAlamoona man adAAafu nasiran waaqallu AAadadan
verses.transliteration_text: Hatta itha raaw ma yooAAadoona fasayaAAlamoona man adAAafu nasiran waaqallu AAadadan

verses.arabic: قُلْ إِنْ أَدْرِىٓ أَقَرِيبٌۭ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ أَمْ يَجْعَلُ لَهُۥ رَبِّىٓ أَمَدًا
verses.english: Say, ‘I do not know if what you are promised is near, or if my Lord has set a [long] term for it.’
verses.transliteration_html: Qul in adree aqareebun ma tooAAadoona am yajAAalu lahu rabbee amadan
verses.transliteration_text: Qul in adree aqareebun ma tooAAadoona am yajAAalu lahu rabbee amadan

verses.arabic: عَـٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ فَلَا يُظْهِرُ عَلَىٰ غَيْبِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا
verses.english: Knower of the Unseen, He does not disclose His [knowledge of the] Unseen to anyone,
verses.transliteration_html: AAalimu alghaybi fala yuthhiru AAala ghaybihi ahadan
verses.transliteration_text: AAalimu alghaybi fala yuthhiru AAala ghaybihi ahadan

verses.arabic: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱرْتَضَىٰ مِن رَّسُولٍۢ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَسْلُكُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِۦ رَصَدًۭا
verses.english: except to an apostle He approves of. Then He dispatches a sentinel before and behind him
verses.transliteration_html: Illa mani irtada min rasoolin fainnahu yasluku min bayni yadayhi wamin khalfihi rasadan
verses.transliteration_text: Illa mani irtada min rasoolin fainnahu yasluku min bayni yadayhi wamin khalfihi rasadan

verses.arabic: لِّيَعْلَمَ أَن قَدْ أَبْلَغُوا۟ رِسَـٰلَـٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ وَأَحْصَىٰ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عَدَدًۢا
verses.english: so that He may ascertain that they have communicated the messages of their Lord, and He encompasses all that is with them, and He keeps an count of all things.
verses.transliteration_html: LiyaAAlama an qad ablaghoo risalati rabbihim waahata bima ladayhim waahsa kulla shayin AAadadan
verses.transliteration_text: LiyaAAlama an qad ablaghoo risalati rabbihim waahata bima ladayhim waahsa kulla shayin AAadadan
